page.overview:
Who is Triad of Terror?

The Triad of Terror, known as Fallguys in the Japanese version, are a group of three Duelists appearing in the Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL anime. They were hired by Quinton and Vetrix to defeat Yuma. It is composed of Jackal, Coyote and Wolfsbane, all of whom were born in the United States of America.

Despite Dueling against Yuma, along with having to deal with Anna Kaboom and Nistro arriving to aide him, all three members were defeated and knocked out of the Duel Carnival.
